title: BaseAgentX
tagline: BaseAgentX : Transform Your RWA Investment Strategies with AI-powered Agents
description: **BaseAgentX** is an autonomous AI-powered agent built on EigenLayer AVS, leveraging the Coinbase Agent Kit and OnchainKit. The agent specializes in carbon credit tokenization, verification, and optimization to enhance sustainability efforts in the decentralized finance ecosystem. BaseAgentX integrates AI-driven strategies with on-chain carbon credit trading and verification using KlimaDAO pools and KLIMA tokens.
how_its_made:
**Tech Stack & Core Components**

**Base** - By leveraging Base, BaseAgentX can optimize yield strategies, automate carbon credit verification, and execute on-chain actions efficiently, making it a robust platform for AI-powered financial automation.

**EigenLayer AVS** – Serves as the decentralized validation layer for AI agent execution. AVS (Actively Validated Services) ensures trust-minimized off-chain computation.

**Coinbase Agent Kit** – Provides the on-chain agent framework, allowing BaseAgentX to operate autonomously within smart contract constraints.

**OnchainKit** – Facilitates modular and composable on-chain agent design.

 **Web3.js**  – Handles Web3 interactions like contract calls, wallet integrations, and transaction management.

**Next.js** – Frontend framework for UI/UX, allowing efficient state management with hooks.

**KlimaDAO** – Acts as the liquidity pool for tokenized carbon credits, enabling swaps, staking, and verification.

**DeFi Strategy Engine** – Implements AI-driven yield optimization strategies (Bearish, Bullish, Moon, Buffet).
